sources.entry: mkdocs-material - A documentation framework and Material Design theme built on MkDocs.

summary.one_liner: Material for MkDocs is a Python-based documentation framework and Material Design theme that turns Markdown files into a searchable static documentation site built on MkDocs.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a theme and framework layered on MkDocs for writing documentation in Markdown and producing a static site. It states the output is searchable, customizable, supports more than 60 languages, and works on all devices. Installation is via pip, and enabling it requires setting the theme name to material in mkdocs.yml. The README points to separate installation and configuration documentation for details. A warning notice says the project reaches end of life on May 5, 2027 and points users to Zensical, a successor from the same team, with a migration guide and a classic theme variant that preserves the current appearance.
use_cases: build a project documentation website from Markdown
create a searchable docs site for an open source project
style an existing MkDocs site with a Material Design theme
generate static documentation for commercial software
how_to_run: Add theme: name: material to mkdocs.yml
Follow the installation guide and configuration documentation linked from the README
notable: Material Design theme for MkDocs with built-in search
Projects listed as users include FastAPI, Pydantic, Ruff, and OpenSSL
Successor project Zensical announced, with a migration guide and a classic theme variant
caveats: Reaches end of life on May 5, 2027; only critical fixes and security updates until then
